```yaml
name: Docker Smoke Test
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  docker-smoke-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to DockerHub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: kha-kis/arr-dashboard
          tags: |
            type=ref,event=branch
            type=ref,event=pr
            type=semver,pattern={{version}}
            type=semver,pattern={{major}}.{{minor}}

      - name: Build and push
        id: build-push
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          platforms: linux/amd64
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

      - name: Run smoke tests
        run: |
          # Pull the built image
          docker pull ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          
          # Start container with test environment
          docker run -d --name test-container \
            -p 3000:3000 \
            -e NODE_ENV=test \
            -e PLEX_TOKEN=test-token \
            -e TAUTULLI_API_KEY=test-key \
            -e SEERR_API_KEY=test-key \
            kha-kis/arr-dashboard:${{ github.sha }}
          
          # Wait for container to be ready
          sleep 10
          
          # Test basic endpoints
          curl -f http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1
          curl -f http://localhost:3000/api/status || exit 1
          
          # Test analytics endpoints
          curl -f http://localhost:3000/api/analytics/plex || exit 1
          curl -f http://localhost:3000/api/analytics/tautulli || exit 1
          
          # Test notification endpoints
          curl -f http://localhost:3000/api/notifications/channels || exit 1
          
          # Test library cleanup endpoints
          curl -f http://localhost:3000/api/cleanup/rules || exit 1
          
          # Test hunting endpoints
          curl -f http://localhost:3000/api/hunting/wanted || exit 1
          
          # Stop container
          docker stop test-container
          docker rm test-container
```
